newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list options on Donna Karan, Sodak Gaming.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list options on Donna Karan, Sodak Gaming.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Monday it would list options on Donna Karan International Inc and Sodak Gaming Inc on October 7.
The exchange said Donna Karan options would have opening strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30 and initial expiration months of October, November, January and April.
Donna Karan shares were down 5/8 at 23-3/8 Monday afternoon.
MLSI/Susquehanna Investment Group will be the specialist.
For Sodak Gaming options, opening strike prices will be 20, 22-1/2 and 25, the AMEX said. It said initial expirations will be in October, November, February and May.
Sodak shares were up 1-3/8 at 22-3/4 Monday afternoon.
AGS Specialist Partners will be the specialist, the AMEX said.
